title: teucrium flavum proles glaucum
intro: Teucrium flavum proles glaucum, commonly known as Glaucous Yellow Frost, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Glaucous Yellow Frost include acting as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful for treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
